source.title: Forebears Zimbabwe forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to replace the legacy seed with broader localized samples. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry.

source.title: ITU Zimbabwe national numbering plan communication of 12.XII.2018

phones.notes: ITU/POTRAZ confirms country code +263, nine-digit mobile national significant numbers, and these mobile NDC/subscriber-block starts. Generated numbers are not checked for live assignment or portability.

source.title: UPU General Addressing Issues countries without postcodes table

locations.notes: UPU lists Zimbabwe among countries that do not require postal codes. postalPrefixes are product-only placeholders for stable generation, not claimed postal codes.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Zimbabwe ordinary passport document entry

passport.notes: PRADO confirms the Zimbabwe ordinary passport document family and document numbering features, but no public passport-number grammar was confirmed. ZWP is a generator marker, not a claimed passport prefix.

national_identity_card_number.label: National Identity Card Number

source.title: Zimbabwe Embassy national identity card service information

national_identity_card_number.notes: Official embassy material confirms the national identity card is issued to citizens from age 16 and is required for several services, but no official public number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed. ID is a generator marker, not a claimed card prefix.
